accepted: Component design can proceed independently of App/Recovery writing: current fixed main has only the controlled fixture importing MessageSettingsPicker. Production host handoff is a separate real requirement.

Required opaque nonserialized draft ownership token plus synchronous host compare/live-authority/validate/write is an appropriate small controlled interface. A key/remount or stale props check alone is insufficient.
Both Apply and explicit omit use ownership checks; original sent/queued receipts remain separate immutable owners; refresh/profile absence/authority unknown cannot silently clear the draft.
Four literal component/test candidates are a design starting point only; no fresh claim/tree/runtime approval. Existing 37 direct/4 browser evidence does not cover new staged controls.
clarificationBeforeImplementation: Separate dialog edit-session lifetime from host draft ownership. A component/dialog can close, cancel or remount while the same view draft still exists; an otherwise-current draft token does not itself revoke an old UI callback. Use a private per-opening liveness guard (invalidated synchronously on cancel/close/navigation/success and on unmount) before invoking the host CAS, or document an equivalent existing mechanism. This is local transient edit state, not another draft store or authorization authority.

Host CAS still independently rejects connection/view/draft replacement, same-value ABA and live permission loss even before React receives updated props. UI liveness must not replace this check. Test ordinary close/unmount without draft rotation separately from actual draft/view/connection invalidation; avoid claiming token equality alone handles both.
